settings.title: Email & calendar
settings.intro: Connect your own Google or Microsoft account. Everything runs in this browser: sign-in uses your own OAuth app, tokens stay in this tab's session storage and are never written to the CRM data.
settings.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
settings.googleClientIdHelp: A "Web application" OAuth client from Google Cloud Console, with this admin's origin authorized.
settings.microsoftClientIdHelp: From your Entra ID (Azure AD) app registration, with this admin URL as a SPA redirect URI.
settings.microsoftTenantHelp: Directory id or domain. Leave empty for "common" (work, school and personal accounts).
settings.autoLog: Log emails I send from a record to its timeline
settings.autoSync: Sync meetings automatically (past 30 and next 30 days) while the admin is open
settings.storageNote: Client ids and these options are stored in this browser (localStorage). Access tokens live only in this tab's session.
settings.shareHelp: Client ids are public values, not secrets. Share them so teammates only need to click Connect. Each user still signs in with their own account.
settings.share: Share client ids with the team
settings.shared: Client ids shared with the team.

connect.prompt: Connect Google or Microsoft to see emails and meetings with this contact.

emails.noAddressHelp: Add an email address to this person to see your exchanges.
emails.noDomainHelp: Add a company domain (not a free-mail one) to see your exchanges.
